Get hands-on with automated AI research. 🔬

We're hosting the NeurIPS 2026 × ML Intern Repro Hackathon, and the idea is pretty simple:

Pick a research paper from NeurIPS 2026, use AI agents to try reproducing its results, and share what you find.

You can use Hugging Face 's ML Intern or other coding agents. Whether you successfully reproduce the results or discover that something doesn't quite add up, there's something valuable to learn and share.

We're keeping everything open, including the code, experiment logs, and results, so others can learn from your work too.

🗓️ Hackathon: Nov 30 – Dec 13, 2026  
📅 Registration closes: Nov 29

Come experiment with us! https://lnkd.in/gxNNwmDy
